semantic_scope: WP17 clauses keep busy/pause/wait/idle distinct; normal display, confirmation and Party/Summary finite receivers have different resume and return gates.
Option lists process direction before BACK/USE, while number entry prioritizes USE and out-of-range USE masks same-frame BACK; cancel remains raw and may equal confirmed value.

Screenshot time/name precedes rescue; primary screenshot failure has one RTP fallback; fallback error propagates, normal sound failure retains file prefix. Controller target-name parsing bounded and native query/bridge remains open.
Keyboard/cursor modes differ for nonpositive max and no cancel; cursor direction and SPECIAL/ACTION/BACK/USE priorities finite; named hosts/media not executed.
Formatted word wrapping has strict +2 gate and no hard split at word origin; pure/end image tags do not enter consuming position; initial input/pause changes may change actual request.
WP63 preserves direct-call versus menu gates; map first-coordinate result and switch hiding, logical movement/interpolation/buttons, fly destination write versus actual WP59 consumption separated.

Phone register prechecks/direct add, alias/raw identity/public-wrapper defects, visible contacts index premise, rematch integer seconds and incoming delta countdown split; make_outgoing record/identifier failure paths not merged.

Phone generation mutates rematch flag independently of playback; per-call TP/TE draws once, first nonempty Land/Cave/Water first four slots uniformly and without dedup; native/OS/input/data bad cases remain named.
Jukebox custom override and current-map flags, empty/missing directory distinction, action order and unexecuted audio request boundaries retain explicit premises.
